title: Bones wins UK Series 7
summary: In the Grand Finale (UK-S07-E10), Bones and Elle Vosque lip-synced to Jimmy Somerville's "You Make Me Feel (Mighty Real)". Bones was crowned the winner; Elle Vosque finished as runner-up. Catrin Feelings and Silllexa Diction placed third and fourth. The series offered a £25,000 cash prize.

title: Pasty: Series 7 Porkchop
summary: After surviving the premiere via The Lucky Cow twist, Pasty was the first contestant eliminated on RuPaul's Drag Race UK Series 7 (UK-S07-E02), lip-syncing to Freemasons and Sophie Ellis-Bextor's "Heartbreak (Make Me a Dancer)" against Viola.

title: The Lucky Cow premiere twist
summary: In UK-S07-E01, Nyongbella and Pasty lip-synced to Charli XCX's "Von Dutch". Nyongbella won the lip sync, but Pasty had been voted The Lucky Cow by the other queens and was saved, so nobody was eliminated.

title: Chai T Grande Miss Congeniality
summary: At the Grand Finale (UK-S07-E10), the eliminated queens returned and Chai T Grande was announced as Miss Congeniality, voted by her fellow contestants. She had been eliminated in UK-S07-E05 after lip-syncing to "Spectrum (Say My Name)".

title: Bonnie Ann Clyde wins Snatch Game
summary: In UK-S07-E07, Bonnie Ann Clyde won Snatch Game as Cher (as a chair). Bones won Reading is Fundamental, then survived a lip sync to Soft Cell's "Tainted Love" against Paige Three, who was eliminated.
